messages:
Rae (PM): dropping a compact prototype — single-line pool row with min/max, burst badge, SLO knob, and a tiny "guardrail" tag. goal: make it scannable in lists. Theo (Designer): looks promising. suggestion: show a very small relative impact next to burst like '+~20ms (est.)' so users see tradeoffs without extra clicks. Ivy (Frontend): hover-only details aren't accessible. provide a keyboard-expand and aria-describedby. also current burst badge color fails AA in dark theme. Noah (SRE): impact should be labeled as estimated and model-aware. wording: '~+20ms (est., per model)' and a tooltip: 'Based on recent serving traces for chosen model'. Dedicated customers could see raw numbers behind a flag. Theo (Designer): microcopy: 'Burst available' vs 'Burst headroom' — which is clearer in a cramped row? Rae (PM): "Burst available" reads cleaner to me; keep label short and add screen-reader text like 'Burst available, estimated latency and cost'. Ivy (Frontend): accessibility note: warnings must be announced. sample: ```
No burst available — requests may queue
``` Make CTA focusable and tabbable. Noah (SRE): behavior: when burst == 0 show inline alert: 'No burst available — requests may queue' with action 'Pick pool with burst' that opens selector. ops-bot, create a feature flag ticket for showing exact headroom to Dedicated. ops-bot: created INF-5601 (burst-inline-flag) assigned to @Noah :white_check_mark: Theo (Designer): layout nit: min/max steppers plus SLO knob crowd the row on narrow screens. propose collapsing steppers into a micro inline control under 420px and expanding on focus. Rae (PM): presets for SLO? research suggested quick presets but people also want fine control. propose visible chips low/med/high that slider snaps to but remains editable. default to medium. Ivy (Frontend): implement slider with snap-to-presets but allow keyboard arrows to nudge by 1 unit. animate changes but respect prefers-reduced-motion and update aria-valuetext to read preset + percent. also announce numeric changes via aria-live. Noah (SRE): add small cost hint when burst used, like '+approx $0.02/min' — labelled estimated. keep cost tiny and optional behind a disclosure to avoid clutter. Theo (Designer): will update mock: compact row, 'Burst available' label, relative impact hint, collapsed steppers, alert copy, visible presets, and optional cost disclosure. Rae (PM): thanks. can Noah/Ivy drop rough estimates into INF-5601 by EOD? I'll attach the mock and link this thread. :thumbsup: Noah (SRE): will add ETA by 5pm. Ivy (Frontend): will add frontend tasks and prototype notes to the ticket. Rae (PM): closing loop aiming to land this in next sprint if estimates look good.
